Paris.detail: Traffic emissions along major boulevards elevate PM2.5. Occasional smog episodes during low-wind periods.

Berlin.detail: Air quality is satisfactory. North Sea winds and urban green spaces keep pollutant levels low.

London.detail: Dense traffic corridors produce elevated NO₂. Low Emission Zone helps but congestion persists.

Madrid.detail: Summer heatwave triggers severe ozone spike. Stagnant air mass traps pollutants — health advisory issued.

Vienna.detail: Excellent air quality supported by extensive public transit and green urban infrastructure.

Milan.detail: Po Valley geography limits air circulation. Industrial activity and traffic contribute to elevated PM2.5.

Warsaw.detail: Coal-based heating in winter months drives PM2.5 spikes. Sensitive groups should limit outdoor exposure.

Prague.detail: Thermal inversion traps coal heating and vehicle emissions in river valley. Traffic restrictions under review.

Munich.detail: Alpine föhn winds occasionally trap ozone. PM2.5 moderate from regional traffic and industry.
